title: Goal Nudge Archive — Daily Habit & KPI Scratchpad
content:
Purpose: a light-weight, daily-forward scratchpad for tracking micro-goals, quick KPI observations, and habit nudges. Not polished — meant to be noisy and useful for pruning weekly.

Quick rules for this doc:
- Only keep single-line bullets for daily entries. If idea gets > 2 lines, move to a proper note or GH gist.
- Mark experiments with EXP: and close with a one-line verdict after 7 days.
- Use the checkbox prefix [ ] for commitments; check when done.
- When I see a trend in metrics, timestamp with (m:YYYY-MM-DD) so I can grep later.

---
Current OKR fragments (working):
O: Increase steady weekly output of focused product work without burning out.
KR1: Average 10 focused hours/week across 4 consecutive weeks (exclude meetings).
KR2: Ship 3 small product improvements that reduce support tickets by 15% (by quarter end).
KR3: Maintain self-reported energy score 6+/10 on average across sprint.

Draft experiments to hit KR1:
- EXP: Block two 90-min deep-focus slots on Tue/Thu mornings for 4 weeks. Hypothesis: reduces context-switch cost, yields +3 productive hours/week. Acceptance: >=3 extra hours on Toggl over baseline and ability to ship at least 1 task each week.
- EXP: Morning micro-ritual (7 min): 2 min review, 3 min prioritize MIT, 2 min calendar guard. If I miss >2 times/week, iterate.

Nudge bank (quick cues to reframe tasks):
- Micro-commitments: "I'll open the PR and write 2 lines of description" (low friction).
- Energy-aware scheduling: put code reviews in afternoon low-energy windows.
- Calendar guard: 10-min buffer around deep blocks to avoid bleed.

Daily log (most recent 14 days) — single-line bullets only:
2026-02-18: [ ] deep slot 1 done (90m). Felt scattered first 20, then 40m solid. (m:2026-02-18)
2026-02-17: Blocked 2hrs, interrupted by ops call; rescheduled. Note: calendar guard not enforced.
2026-02-16: EXP started: morning micro-ritual, completed 5/7. Tracked energy 7/10.
2026-02-15: Shipped small QA fix that cut one recurring ticket (ticket#4532). Quick win.
2026-02-14: No deep work; mental fog. Did 1 PR review.
2026-02-13: [x] deep slot 2 done. Focus felt better after skipping Slack for 60m.
2026-02-12: Low output, long meeting day. Energy 5/10.
2026-02-11: Wrote spec outline for caching evals (15m). Good momentum.
2026-02-10: Rest day for focus experiment, read research notes.
2026-02-09: [x] 90m deep slot, progressed metric dashboard.
2026-02-08: 30m PR polish; still behind on checklist.
2026-02-07: Team sync ate time; moved deep slot to evening and canceled.
2026-02-06: Quick wins: triaged 8 tickets, log energy 6/10.
2026-02-05: EXP: missed micro-ritual twice; still 1 small win (doc review).
2026-02-04: Good day: 2 focused hours, friction at 4pm.

Weekly check-in template (to copy into weekly summary):
- Wins: small shipped items (list + ticket numbers)
- Noise: meetings / interruptions + mitigation ideas
- Energy: average score + qualitative notes
- Experiment snapshot: active EXP and early signals (positive/neg/neutral)
- Next week plan: 3 MITs and 2 calendar rules

Example weekly summary (week ending 2026-02-18):
- Wins: shipped QA fix (ticket#4532), spec outline for caching evals (PR #768).
- Noise: 2 unexpected ops escalations; need to add "escalation buffer" on Tue afternoons.
- Energy: avg 6.4/10; better when deep slots happen.
- Experiments: deep-slot scheduling shows signal: 4/7 days had focused blocks with +1.8 hrs above baseline; need another week. Morning micro-ritual partially implemented; completion 5/7.
- Next week: commit to Tue/Thu deep slots, protect 20m pre-block buffer, reduce meetings on Wed where possible.

Open questions / decisions to make:
- Should I collapse meetings into two deep-off days, or distribute them but shorten? (pros/cons in comments)
- Is Toggl tagging accurate enough for KR1? If not, quick audit needed (task: audit last 30 days tags, Jira: PROJ-949).
- How strict should energy target be? Maybe move to median instead of average to avoid outlier days.

Ideas to try next:
- EXP: "No-Slack first 90" on deep days — incentives: 1 coffee reward if completed twice in a week.
- EXP: daily 10-min tidy: close old tabs, triage inbox (expected time savings: 20m/day).

Retrospective notes (monthly cadence):
- What worked: scheduled deep slots + pre-block buffer helped reduce context switching cost.
- What didn't: morning ritual adoption was spotty; friction was forgetting to open the page. Fix: add small morning reminder on phone + very short checklist.
- Follow-ups: create a lightweight dashboard query to compare focused hours to PR throughput (create a saved report — CONFLUENCE:INTERNAL-OKR-W17/queries/focused_vs_prs).

Archive section (closed experiments / lessons):
- EXP: "Inbox zero sprint" (2025-09) — outcome: temporary uplift in perceived clarity but rebound after 3 weeks. Lesson: short-term hacks need structural change.
- EXP: "Pomodoro push" (2025-12) — outcome: helped with small tasks but fragmented larger deep work. Lesson: reserve longer uninterrupted blocks for heads-down tasks.

Action backlog (one-liners only):
- Audit Toggl tags for last 30 days (Jira: PROJ-949)
- Add phone reminder for morning ritual (create one-liner, set recurring)
- Make a one-page runbook for handling ops escalations during deep days
- Create PR template that prompts for "estimated dev time" to better track KR progress

Notes to self: keep this doc noisy. If a thing persists > 2 weeks, move to a proper project doc or convert to a ticket. If collaborators add comments, tag with initials and date.

Last quick log — 2026-02-18 18:22: small win: blocked a 90m deep slot and used the first 10m for "intent framing" (worth keeping).

END
